read.thesis: Dow's Q2 earnings jump on a 20% local price surge led by polyethylene, while volume fell 1%; the self-help uplift is real but price, not supply discipline, drove the quarter.

triggers.label: Local price +20% YoY
triggers.quote: Local price increased 20% versus the year-ago period, led by gains in Packaging & Specialty Plastics, with higher polyethylene prices in all regions.

triggers.label: Transform to Outperform +$200M benefits
triggers.quote: We now expect to generate approximately $200 million more in benefits from Transform to Outperform this year

triggers.label: Working capital build, receivables up
triggers.quote: Cash provided by operating activities – continuing operations was $1.3 billion, primarily driven by higher earnings across all businesses, more than offsetting an expected working capital build

guidance.quote: increase the total in-year benefits from self-help to greater than $1.3 billion

red_flags.label: Working capital build; receivables up sharply
red_flags.quote: more than offsetting an expected working capital build, reflecting revenue growth
